description: Draft a factual standup from git commits and pull request activity you supply: merged work under Done, open pull requests in progress, the rest counted.

author.description: When given, only this author's commits and pull requests are included (exact match) (optional)

hash.description: Commit hash (rendered as its first 7 characters)

date_label.description: Label for the standup heading (optional, default "Yesterday")

number.description: Pull request number (unique across the set)

state.description: What happened to the pull request: opened, updated, merged, or closed

name: generate_standup
